promotion_gate.primary_endpoint: strict protected deterministic attempt by end of Kinnan T4

architectures.hypothesis: A denser self-contained clone/copy shell increases deterministic-node redundancy without requiring opponent permanents.
architectures.notes: Keep Mockingbird already present in F10. Measure copied-target classes separately when target instrumentation is available; deck-level endpoint remains primary.

architectures.hypothesis: Creature-heavy clone density better exploits Kinnan hits and creature tutors than enchantment/artifact-heavy copy density.
architectures.notes: Mockingbird remains. This package is structurally different from ARCH_COPY_CORE and should be compared as an architecture, not inferred from singleton prevalence.

architectures.hypothesis: Devoted Druid plus Machine God's Effigy creates an additional compact deterministic mana node that connects to existing Kinnan outlets/tutors.
architectures.notes: Forge rules/pilot already contain explicit Effigy-copy-of-Devoted-Druid deterministic-state handling; verify current card support before scheduling the full screen.

architectures.hypothesis: Combining clone redundancy with the Druid/Effigy node creates more cross-connected deterministic paths than either package alone.
architectures.notes: Only escalate if either pure architecture survives its first controlled screen; do not spend confirmation compute on this hybrid otherwise.

retirement_rules: Retire architecture early for materially worse paired strict-protected-T4 performance with no compensating pod/seat signal.
Do not promote from tournament prevalence or 100-200 paired games.
Only derive 2-6 card packages after an architecture shows a credible signal.
Singleton screens remain rejection-only and require exposure-conditioned reporting.
